name: Ember Sigil
blurb: An ember set in steel: it raises a guard at the start of each fight.

name: Thorn Sigil
blurb: A thorn set in steel: your first attack hit of each fight makes the foe bleed.

name: Tide Sigil
blurb: A tide set in steel: every few cards you play in a fight draw you another.

name: Hearth Sigil
blurb: A hearth set in steel: whenever you heal, it raises a guard.

name: Sigil of the Last Vigil
blurb: A candle that never gutters: when you enter a fight already wounded, it raises a guard.

name: Pyre Sigil
blurb: An ember of the old pyres: every card you burn away raises a guard.

name: Gravelight Sigil
blurb: A cold light over the barrows: while you stand wounded, each foe that falls mends you.
